verdict.rationale: RudderStack Profiles are declared in version-controlled YAML. Transformations can be tested against sample events before deploying and managed programmatically through the Transformations and Libraries API. Audit logs are accessible via API and MCP, giving some review and history capability. missing for 10: explicit versioning of transformations and pipelines, any documented rollback or revert mechanism, a review/approval workflow for automation changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
